title: Income Support Law, 5741-1980
source_id: ס״ח תשמ״א, 30 (further publication at ס״ח תשמ״א, 77); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000193; Wikisource page חוק הבטחת הכנסה
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק הבטחת הכנסה, התשמ״א–1980; metadata gives ס״ח תשמ״א, 30 and 77 and Knesset lawitemid 2000193; most recent amendment noted תשפ״ה, 505 (2025). The commencement provision as printed brings the Law into force on ו׳ בטבת התשמ״ב (1 January 1982), with power for the Minister of Labour to bring provisions into force at later dates for particular categories of beneficiary.
notes: This is the means-tested safety net (הבטחת הכנסה / השלמת הכנסה), administered by the National Insurance Institute, and it is the benefit a person with no other entitlement is actually governed by. The staged-commencement power in the commencement section means any historical point-in-time question before the mid-1980s needs the commencement orders checked, not just the Law. The benefit rates are set by reference to a percentage of the average wage and by regulation, not as fixed figures in the Law.
